column1: # The triggers that pick the plan tier with no question to the owner (scripts/plan-tier.sh). To change them, copy this file to
# the project's .claude/plan-triggers.tsv and edit that copy: a project's own file replaces this one whole.
# One trigger a line, three tab-separated columns: the tier (panel, panel-always or none), a lowercase extended regex
# matched against the lowercased batch brief, and the name Auto prints. A panel trigger on any line picks Panel; a batch
# estimated under 150 changed lines then gets one judge, unless a panel-always trigger matched too. No plan only
# when every item line of "## The issues" matches a none trigger. Anything else is Plan + judge.
